_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Find companies by industry and country...

description: List companies of one industry in one country from two open registers: Wikidata (companies whose industry or business type matches, the best known first, with website, founding date, head count and LEI) and GLEIF's LEI index (active legal entities in the country whose legal name holds the industry word, as found_in gleif). industries lists the Wikidata items the words were read as; send a Wikidata item id such as Q880371 (software industry) for an exact industry. Wikidata rows with a LEI carry the GLEIF legal entity. Coverage follows what Wikidata and GLEIF hold, so small firms are often missing. No person is named. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 code (DE, US, VN) or an English country name (Germany).

industry.description: Industry words, such as software, bank or car manufacturer, or a Wikidata item id such as Q880371.

page_size.description: Wikidata companies to return, 1 to 50 (default 20); up to 10 GLEIF entities are added.

name: data_company_discover
title: Find companies by industry and country
